description: Deletes an automation. One that is switched on is switched off with it, no run starts after it, it leaves the list of automations, and its id stops answering. Each call needs confirming: without confirmation_token it changes nothing and returns a preview and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it deletes.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

name: delete_automation
title: Delete an automation
